host.label: ALWAYS ON HOST — Kubuntu 26.04 LTS workstation
host.container_runtime: Podman 5.7.0 — Quadlet only, no Docker daemon

interfaces.name: eno1
interfaces.role: Podman host-side bridge address + 10.42.0.1:5432 socat PostgreSQL relay

interfaces.name: lo
interfaces.role: All operator listeners are loopback-only by policy

databases.label: Host PostgreSQL 18.6 cluster
databases.role: System-wide relational platform. One cluster, separate logical databases, separate application roles. REVOKE CONNECT FROM PUBLIC enforced.
databases.note: Target end state. Some applications still run container-scoped PostgreSQL during migration.

databases.label: salesdb
databases.role: Authoritative sales/payment records: customers, orders, products, payments, receipts, entitlements, audit history.
databases.note: Repository schema defined; live salesdb application schema still requires explicit initialization. Container-scoped sales-db exists today.

databases.label: mastodon
databases.role: Mastodon application state: accounts, posts, media metadata, federation state, background-job data.
databases.note: CONSOLIDATION INCOMPLETE: container-scoped mastodon-db is running on ao-sales while the documented target is the host cluster.

databases.label: webodm (PostGIS)
databases.role: Mapping projects, processing state, users, geospatial data.
databases.note: Large image/output artifacts remain filesystem data on /media/scottw/500GBPHOTOGRAM/.

databases.label: grafana
databases.role: Grafana users, dashboards, folders, datasource definitions, preferences, alert state.
databases.note: Not a disposable dashboard: requires backup, restore testing, migrations, health checks.

databases.label: metabase
databases.role: Metabase users, collections, questions, dashboards, database connections, settings.
databases.note: Persistence confirmation and first protected read-only query are open items.

databases.label: cordadb (Corda persistence)
databases.software: PostgreSQL 18 — separate logical database with its own roles and backup scope
databases.role: Corda persistence. AUTHORITATIVE LEDGER for sale/contract, receipt association, entitlement, approved state transitions.
databases.note: Corda 5.2.2 persists in cordadb. Corda 4.14.2 (H2) was retired 2026-09-28; it was a separate legacy scaffold, never a Corda 5 staging target, and held no ledger state. Blocked on operator key/certificate ceremony (v6 18.2/18.3).

databases.label: postgres (administrative)
databases.role: Administrative/maintenance database for the shared cluster.

databases.label: Host Redis 8.0.5 (database 0)
databases.role: General low-latency cache/coordination layer. NOT a system of record; no current application data confirmed.

databases.label: mastodon-redis (database 0)
databases.role: Mastodon cache, queues, background-job coordination. Not authoritative business data.

databases.label: broker (database 0)
databases.role: Celery/task broker and worker coordination. Not authoritative mapping data.

databases.label: Prometheus TSDB
databases.role: Specialized time-series store: metrics, service health, resource usage, operational monitoring. Works without Grafana.
databases.note: Grafana visualizes metrics; Prometheus remains the separate metrics store and the alerting layer.

databases.label: OpenClaw SQLite state
databases.role: Local operational state. Not part of SQL reporting.

databases.label: Akonadi / KDE PIM SQLite
databases.role: Contacts, calendars, mail indexes, local personal-information data.

databases.label: Browser profile SQLite stores
databases.software: SQLite (Konqueror/KDE WebEngine, Firefox, Brave, Chrome, Edge)
databases.role: History, site storage, caches, certificates, profile data.

databases.label: Podman rootless metadata store
databases.role: Container, image, network, volume metadata. Not application data.

databases.label: ROS / simulation local SQLite
databases.role: Local tool state where enabled. Not a shared reporting source.

databases.label: Filesystem / local application state
databases.software: Application files, logs, project files, local state
databases.role: Operational or engineering data that is not automatically part of SQL reporting.

databases.label: Photogrammetry media (filesystem, ext4)
databases.role: Source imagery, orthophotos, point clouds, 3D model artifacts. Large binaries stay filesystem-resident; only metadata is in webodm.
databases.note: Deploy or operate WebODM only after the drive and mount are validated (v6 8.5).

databases.label: H2 legacy migration backups
databases.role: No longer active; retained temporarily for rollback and migration evidence.
databases.note: H2 and SQLite are NOT approved application databases for Grafana or Metabase. Separately, the Corda H2 scaffold is a known defect (see cordadb).

host_services.label: PostgreSQL 18.6 (host cluster)
host_services.data: System-wide relational platform: separate logical databases, separate application roles
host_services.note: AUTHORITATIVE RELATIONAL. REVOKE CONNECT FROM PUBLIC enforced (v6 3.3). Target is one host cluster; container-scoped instances are current migration state.

host_services.label: Redis 8.0.5 (host service)
host_services.data: Low-latency cache/coordination layer (not a system of record)

host_services.label: ArduPilot SITL (host systemd service)
host_services.note: Runs on host for real-time constraints; QGroundControl connects over tcp:5760 (v6 10.1)

host_services.label: restic encrypted backup (host)
host_services.software: restic — encrypted local snapshots + encrypted pCloud replication
host_services.data: PostgreSQL/Corda-aware encrypted backup; restore test in an isolated location
host_services.note: Local authority + encrypted restic + encrypted pCloud replication. Independent of IPFS and Corda (v6 ES.1).

host_services.label: KDE Wallet (kwalletd6) — secret authority
host_services.software: org.kde.kwalletd6 via Plasma login → kwalletd6 unlock → fetch-kwallet-secret.sh (ExecStartPre, ≤60s)
host_services.data: 0600 env file per unit; services needing Wallet secrets start AFTER login BY DESIGN
host_services.note: Secret authority is settled; the D-Bus bus name and method names on the running host are unconfirmed (v6 14.1.1).

desktop_software.software: RNS embedded; standalone rnsd 1.4.2 present but not running
desktop_software.note: 29 TCPClientInterface peers + 1 BackboneInterface + 2 RNode interfaces in ~/.reticulum/config (README 9.3)

desktop_software.label: LM Studio headless inference server

desktop_software.label: Konqueror (browser; Tokodon removed per ES.1)
desktop_software.note: Tokodon was removed completely per v6 ES.1. No Podman network attachment; loopback only.

desktop_software.label: DBeaver (SQL client)
desktop_software.software: DBeaver — SQL client for the host PostgreSQL 18 cluster
desktop_software.note: Named in the v6 ES.2 master topology on the ao-data narrow-plumbing path.

desktop_software.label: SketchUp / SketchUp Web (design, host)
desktop_software.note: DESIGN path in the v6 ES.2 master topology. GPU policy priority: desktop/Konqueror → LM Studio/OpenClaw → SketchUp → ROS/Gazebo/SITL → WebODM batch (v6 ES.1).
